Answer: We help identify repetitive business processes, map current manual steps, and design n8n workflows with human approval where needed.
The service focuses on controlled AI agents that reason over business context while deterministic workflow nodes handle validation, routing, logging, and notifications.
A simple proof of concept can usually be demonstrated in days, while production rollout depends on integrations, credential setup, approval rules, and user testing.
Budget depends on workflow complexity, number of systems integrated, and whether the solution needs hosted infrastructure, private data handling, or custom user interfaces.
For regulated or high-impact communication, the workflow should generate drafts for review instead of sending external messages without approval.
RAG lets the chatbot answer from approved documents, service notes, FAQs, and process guides instead of relying only on general model knowledge.
We build client communication assistants that draft careful replies, classify sentiment and urgency, then route sensitive messages through Gmail or Slack approval before sending.
We build CRM follow-up agents that summarize enquiries, draft personalized follow-up emails, update lead stages, and remind sales teams when prospects need attention.
We build OCR and document AI workflows that extract invoice, receipt, contract, or form data, validate fields, and push structured records into Sheets, Airtable, Supabase, or accounting tools.
We build inventory and operations agents that monitor stock files or databases, detect low-stock risks, draft supplier messages, and log audit trails for replenishment decisions.
We build HR screening assistants that score resumes against role criteria, summarize candidate fit, flag missing information, and prepare recruiter review notes without making final hiring decisions.
We build reporting agents that collect operational data, summarize weekly performance, detect anomalies, and send concise management briefings through email, chat, or dashboards.
We build onboarding assistants that guide new customers through setup steps, answer approved FAQs, collect missing details, and escalate complex or sensitive questions to a human.
